description: Use this when a farm, business or fleet in Ireland asks about green diesel (marked gas oil) or delivered road diesel prices. Returns per-litre prices for 500 and 1,000 litres from Irish oil suppliers that publish them, the typical and lowest price, weekly medians and a link to get quotes. HVO prices are not published online in Ireland. Do not use for pump prices at forecourts.

fuel.description: GREEN_DIESEL is marked gas oil for farms, plant and heating; ROAD_DIESEL is diesel for road vehicles.

name: tankful_business_fuel_prices
title: Green diesel and road diesel prices
